BiblicalUsage: Casiphia is a place in Babylon where Ezra sent for Levites and temple servants to join the return to Jerusalem. It is named once, at the moment when Ezra would not go up to the house of God without the men appointed to serve there.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Casiphia matters because Ezra would rather wait than go without God's servants. The work of the house needs the people of the house — and that is still true.
